name: Chitose
source:
Motoi's younger sister. She's at the age to fall in love, hence why she kind of stalks the "prince" Yuzuki.

Motoi often lectures her, but she never listens to him.

[Translated from [url=http://b-cluster.eek.jp/requartz/character/chitose.html]official wesbite[/url]]
